pro_course_detail.title: Reach for English! A Fun, Interactive Course to Build Reading, Speaking, & Writing Skills
pro_course_detail.description:
*This course is geared toward children ages 4 - 12. *

What will I learn in this course?
Reach for English is a course designed in collaboration with National Geographic Learning. It is a fun, interactive course with 3 Main Emphases: Reading, Speaking, & Writing. The lessons are all based on picture book stories, focusing on the development of reading skills. We will build English skills by focusing on phonics, grammar, spelling, listening & speaking comprehension, and oral writing.

What happens during a lesson?
In an individual class, we will begin with a Warm-Up to help students get into “English Mode.” We will also discuss the goals for today’s lesson and introduce the lesson topic. We will follow up with review when applicable, introduce new vocabulary and grammar, and play practise games. Together, we will read a story and practise discussion skills by asking and answering questions about the story as we read. We will end our lesson by writing sentences about the story using our new vocabulary.

How long is this course?
Each Course is 30 lessons long and may be purchased by individual lesson or in 10-course increments. 

What level is this course?
This course is accessible to Levels PREK - G4A. 

How is my progress?
I provide written feedback after every fifth lesson. This personalised report will provide a constructive, encouraging review of your listening and speaking skills, classroom engagement, foundational skills, and reading & oral writing skills. 

Can I review lessons after class?
Yes! All lessons are recorded independently by me and will be forwarded to the client after each session. Recordings are to ensure continued quality. Student information remains private.

What materials do you provide for each lesson?
Prior to each lesson, I provide relevant student enrichment materials such as practise book pages and videos. I do not require a student to have reviewed or completed these materials prior to the lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Reading Tree - Learn English Through the Adventures of Kipper, Chip, Biff & More!
pro_course_detail.description:

This course is designed to facilitate the development of essential English skills for effective learning through reading while helping learners become independent readers. In each lesson, we will build English skills by focusing on reading strategies & skills, vocabulary, speaking, fluency, phonics & phonological awareness, and writing.

In an individual class, we will begin with a Warm-Up to help students get into “English Mode.” We will also discuss the goals for that lesson and introduce the lesson topic. We will follow up with review when applicable, learn phonics, and improve pronunciation. Together, we will read a story and discuss it, building comprehension, vocabulary, and accuracy. Afterwards, we will practise retelling the story, practise free talk using new vocabulary, and practise oral writing.

teacher_info.introduction: Hi there, my name is Libby and I can't wait to join you on your language learning adventures! Over the years, I've studied French, Ancient Greek, Latin, Old French, German, and Toki Pona in many different situations. I've taken classes at the high school and college level, in both the United States and abroad; I've received private tutoring; and I was selected by the Modern Languages Department of the College of William & Mary to serve as a French tutorffffffffffffff. And now that I've graduated college, I'm studying new languages on my own. So, no matter what your background in language is, I understand where you're coming from and I'm happy to adapt to your individual goals and learning style. If you are interested in learning French, I am experienced in teaching grammatical concepts to students of all levels, and my background in Latin and Old French (the French of the middle ages) means I have a unique perspective on etymology and historical French, if that's something that interests you. I know that learning a new language takes more than the few hours per week that we'll have together, so I want to help you build a comprehensive strategy, using whatever combination of traditional study tools, online resources, and immersion opportunities suits you. If you are interested in learning Ancient Greek, I'm ready with lessons on the alphabet, vocabulary, and multiple approaches to grammar. My broad familiarity with Indo-European languages has exposed me to many ways of explaining these sometimes confusing grammatical concepts. Once you've learned the basics, or if you're already comfortable with them, we can move on to translating genuine ancient texts together. The dialect that I learned is Attic (the language of Plato), but if you understand that dialect, it's very easy to move to Ionic (the language of Homer) and Koine (the language of the New Testament). Please let me know if you would prefer to talk through skype or google hangouts.

pro_course_detail.title: Let's talk about literature
pro_course_detail.description:
It is no secret that one of the best ways to improve foreign language skills is to read in them as much as possible. In fact, our knowledge of languages can perhaps best be measured in the kilometers of text we’ve read in them!

Literature provides access to a treasure trove of language, which we can use to enrich our own speech, writing and understanding. It provides the absolute best examples of careful and precise language usage, from which we can learn more than any English textbook.

At the same time, reading in a foreign language allows us to discover and explore new worlds. But instead of traveling through space, we travel through text! Reading is, perhaps, the best way to deepen our understanding of other cultures. The universe of literature written in English or translated into this language is boundless, and your journey though it can provide lifelong enjoyment!  

As a teacher of literature, I can help you make reading in English interesting and fun!

Before the lesson you will read a short story, essay, poem, or extract of a longer text in English. The text will never be too long, and will be chosen in accordance with your skill level. If you want to read a whole novel, please tell me, and we will make a study plan.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons will be conversation based and YOU will be doing most of the speaking. Either you will pick topics or I will pick topics that are relevant to your English journey- you can decide.

I will correct some of your mistakes during the lesson. I don't correct every single mistake but I will either correct you on the spot or will note all important mistakes. Sometimes it's necessary to wait until you have completed a sentence or thought before any correction should be done- it's important to also practice flow when speaking a foreign language. 

You will receive feedback from me via email after (or at the very end of) each lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: General English lessons / Grammar lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
General English lessons:

Our lessons will incorporate speaking, listening, writing, and grammar. Lessons will be tailored to meet your needs! I will send notes after each lesson, share relevant materials, and assign homework.

While we are in our lessons, we will probably divide the time up into two categories - speaking and grammar. Half the time we will focus on grammar, and half the time on speaking. Homework assigned will usually require you to do some writing, listening, reading, and definitely reviewing. 

After the first few lessons, I'll make a plan for us to follow- it's usually about a 40-lesson syllabus. We don't have to follow it, but it will be a helpful guide for us.

Grammar lessons:

In these lessons, we'll dive deep into all the questions that you might have about grammar. If you don't have specific questions, I will guide you with resources and I will explain with clarity how and why we formulate our sentences the way that we do. I will provide you with trustworthy, additional resources so you can learn from multiple perspectives. Our lessons will be completely customized to meet your needs.

Sometimes I teach grammar in the lessons and then assign homework- and sometimes I first assign homework and then the student "presents" what they've learned. Both systems work really well- the first system working well with A1-B2 students, and the second working well with B2-C1 students.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Workout*
pro_course_detail.description:
If you need to simply chat with a native speaker to practice your English, these informal conversation lessons are just for you. Perhaps you have a presentation you need to practice for, or a speaking exam tomorrow, or you're getting ready to travel abroad and need to warm up a bit. You will bring the topics and you will steer the conversation! 

*Lessons for adults only. Please note that if you'd like homework, lesson plans, or written feedback please take my speaking lessons instead.

pro_course_detail.title: English for young learners
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons will be mostly conversation based with lots of activities and games, especially with very young learners. This is an important age for language learning because kids learn QUICKLY and EASILY, and they learn the best without formal teaching. Students are pushed to speak, but on their own time- I build trust and focus on their confidence before any formal teaching. With most of my younger learners, I encourage NO formal teaching; it is better that they see me as a "friend" rather than a teacher (kids have enough school already!). At the end of the day, the lesson style is up to the parent- if the parent prefers me to formally teach, I will do that. 
When I am not "formally teaching" I am noting the student's frequent mistakes and new words, and I use the drilling method. After lots of repetition they will naturally correct their mistakes. 
*I only teach 30 minute lessons with very young learners- if there is a specific circumstance we can discuss 45-minute lessons.
